content.rendered:
A public meeting of the Budget Committee of the Sherwood School District to discuss the budget for the fiscal year July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022, will take place on Wednesday, June 2, 2021 at 5:15pm. This meeting will take place at the District Office Board Room at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd. The agenda for this meeting can be found here. The 2021-22 Proposed Budget can be found here.

Our District is now allowing in-person attendance at all public meetings. Additionally, members of the public attending District public meetings may remove face coverings indoors upon showing written verification of COVID vaccine status, as per OHA guidance; face coverings will be required for all attendees who choose not to provide verification of vaccine status, or will be required of all attendees if students are in attendance. The District will also offer a live stream of the Budget Committee meeting on our YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

Public testimony on the topic of the 2021-22 can be submitted virtually using the form found here. Public testimony will be accepted until this item on the agenda during the live meeting.  All public testimony submitted in advance will be read aloud by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes in length per comment.  Public testimony on the topic of the 2021-22 budget can also be provided in-person at the meeting, up to three minutes in length (sign-up required prior to start of meeting).

In the event that the Budget Committee meeting is continued to a future date, the second meeting of the Committee will be held on Thursday, June 3 at 5:30pm.
